content_sections.heading: GGU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 22 vacancies are available - 10 for Special Project Associate (SPA), 10 for Field Assistant (FA) and 2 for Data Entry Operator (DEO).

content_sections.heading: GGU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Special Project Associate (SPA): Post Graduate degree in Environmental Sciences/ Forestry/ Basic Science/ Natural Sciences and related discipline from a recognized University/Institute. CAMPA experience preferred. Understanding of forest and plantation. Ability and willingness to engage with local communities and collect field data using forestry research tools. Ability to conduct secondary research. Knowledge of data analysis and Excellent report writing skills. Field Assistant (FA): Graduate degree in Environmental Sciences/ Forestry/ Basic Science/ Natural Sciences/ Social Sciences and related discipline from a recognized University/ Institute. CAMPA experience preferred. Understanding of forest and plantation. Ability and willingness to engage with local communities and collect field data using forestry research tools. Ability to conduct secondary research. Excellent data analysis and report writing skills. Knowledge of Computer. Data Entry Operator (DEO): Graduation degree from any recognized University/Institute. Person with experience will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GGU Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the GGU Project Staff recruitment is 01 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications or attend the walk-in interview before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Staff at GGU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies for Project Staff posts announced by Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya. These vacancies are distributed across various positions like Special Project Associate, Field Assistant, and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for GGU Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the GGU Project Staff recruitment is scheduled to be held on 05 October 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Field Assistant (FA) post is a Graduate degree in Environmental Sciences, Forestry, Basic Science, Natural Sciences, or Social Sciences from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Special Project Associate (SPA) position?
faq.answer: The Special Project Associate (SPA) position offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month. This is a project-based role with a fixed monthly emolument.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, a biodata, a filled proforma (if applicable), and a passport-size photograph to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya?
faq.answer: The official website of Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya is http://www.ggu.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information about the university and its recruitments.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these Project Staff posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview, which may be conducted in either online or offline mode.
